sections.heading: How to wear ?
sections.text:
1. Gently slide the bangle over your hand onto your wrist.

2. Adjust so the polished surface sits comfortably in place.

3. Wear solo for a bold statement, or stack with other bangles and bracelets.

4. After wear, wipe with a soft dry cloth and store in a dry pouch.

 Product Description
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 Meet the Bold Golden Bangle – 24K Gold Tone — a statement piece designed with a clean, substantial silhouette that brings confidence, shine and timeless luxury to your wrist.
Its sleek structured design creates a smooth, polished appearance, while the rich 24K gold tone finish adds a golden glow that catches the light beautifully. The bold profile makes it an effortless choice for anyone who loves jewellery with a strong yet refined presence.

• 
Bold bangle design — clean structure with timeless appeal

• 
24K gold tone — rich shine with a premium finish

• 
6mm width — a refined statement with balanced proportions

• 
26.15 cm length — designed for comfortable everyday styling

Wear it with casual outfits, festive looks, office wear or special occasions — on its own for a strong, minimal statement or stacked with other bangles and bracelets for a layered look. However you style it, the Bold Golden Bangle adds an effortless touch of confidence, sophistication and polished golden luxury.

sections.heading: FAQ
sections.text:
collapsible-row-list-item__label">
 

 
 FAQ
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 1. Is it real gold?

No — it is a premium 24K gold tone finish, giving you the rich look of gold at an accessible price.

2. What is the size of the bangle?

It measures 26.15 cm in length with a balanced 6mm width — a comfortable fit for everyday wear.

3. Can I wear it every day?

Yes. The smooth, structured build sits comfortably on the wrist all day. Keep it away from water and perfume to preserve the shine.

4. Will it feel too heavy or bulky?

Not at all. The 6mm width gives it a bold presence while staying balanced and comfortable — a statement without the weight.

5. Can I stack it with other bangles?

Absolutely. Wear it solo for a strong, clean statement or pair it with other bangles and bracelets for a layered look.
